title: The Town That Couldn't Stop Dancing

lines.tts: In 1518, a woman started dancing in the street, and a whole town couldn't stop.
lines.text: In 1518, a woman started dancing in the street, and a whole town couldn't stop.

lines.tts: It's July in Strasbourg, and Frau Troffea steps out of her house and just starts dancing. No music. No smile.
lines.text: It's July in Strasbourg, and Frau Troffea steps out of her house and just starts dancing. No music. No smile.

lines.tts: Her husband begs her to stop. She can't. She dances for six days straight.
lines.text: Her husband begs her to stop. She can't. She dances for six days straight.

lines.tts: By the end of the week, thirty neighbors are dancing with her.
lines.text: By the end of the week, thirty neighbors are dancing with her.

lines.tts: By August, records say it's hundreds.
lines.text: By August, records say it's hundreds.

lines.tts: So the town council meets, and they come up with a plan.
lines.text: So the town council meets, and they come up with a plan.

lines.tts: If they can't stop dancing, let them dance it out.
lines.text: If they can't stop dancing, let them dance it out.

lines.tts: They build a stage, hire a band, and pay strong young men to keep the dancers moving.
lines.text: They build a stage, hire a band, and pay strong young men to keep the dancers moving.

lines.tts: It does not help. The music just pulls in more dancers.
lines.text: It does not help. The music just pulls in more dancers.

lines.tts: You see, the town was starving, sick and terrified, and fear spreads through a crowd like a yawn.
lines.text: You see, the town was starving, sick and terrified, and fear spreads through a crowd like a yawn.

lines.tts: Ever watched one person yawn, and then the whole room yawns too? Nobody chooses it. It just jumps.
lines.text: Ever watched one person yawn, and then the whole room yawns too? Nobody chooses it. It just jumps.

lines.tts: One frightened dancer became thirty, and thirty became hundreds.
lines.text: One frightened dancer became thirty, and thirty became hundreds.

lines.tts: So the council finally does the opposite. They ban music in public, and send the dancers to a quiet shrine in the hills.
lines.text: So the council finally does the opposite. They ban music in public, and send the dancers to a quiet shrine in the hills.

lines.tts: The town cured a dancing plague by doing the one thing nobody at a party ever does: turning off the music.
